The thief, out of fear of facing a lion, becomes a man driven by fear of facing a lion cub.
The thief extends winter to the beginning of summer.
They saw a thief at noon. They …… but it blinded them to him. Thus he carried the loot away.
When a burglar makes a hole, he makes it narrow.
The owner of a house should reinforce the windows against burglars.
They caught a burglar breaking into a house: @q{“Let me …….”}
A hired worker who was lifting a rudder upwards …… gathering wood …… said: @q{“What I gave you at the boat's bow -- let me now give it to you from the boat's stern. Do you know what it is?”}
Even the strongest labourer gets beaten by the owner of the barley.
A crafty man does not transgress against his mother.
A crafty man lays on a party for his neighbour.
A crafty man exhorts the crowd: @q{“Seize him! Drive him away!”}
The load is heavy for the crafty ones. Twice their knees go weak …….
The crafty one wrapped herself in double-woven cloth and …… from her jar of pressed oil as if from a river.
The crafty one hung whatever precious metal there was about herself.
A crafty one …….
A stone to a crafty man is two halves of a shekel.
The head -- a crafty person …… throughout the Land; and he, being crafty, speaks incessantly about his head.
A lame man spoke to his mother: @q{“Where a man reclines in a chair, it is really comfortable!”} His mother replied: @q{“What is he afraid of? When did we last see you run away anywhere?”}
A lame man saw some runners: @q{“The people who disappeared, where did they go?”} he asked.
A lame man spoke: @q{“Oh feet of mine, walk!”}
A lame man came running to the New Year festival and a man said to him: @q{“Insofar as you were lame, you wouldn't be able to do that!”}
A …… lost his shoes. The man who found them said: @q{“Where shall I take them? …… for me?”}

As the gardeners chased some boys away, one stayed where he was while another ate at his pleasure. The one who was hiding in the trees could not be encouraged to come out. Afraid, the one who stood where he was and who had been caught said: @q{“I will come down to you; and let the others here join me in coming down to you.”} @note{The gardener replied:} @q{“Your collaboration is pleasing; I will not have you castigated in your father's house.”}
